pages.ld_description: Christmas Tree Ricky Rain Frog did not sign up for this. One minute Ricky was minding his own business, nursing a mug of tea. The next, he’s wrapped in tinsel, jammed into a tree costume, and blinking through fairy lights. (“It’s festive, Ricky!” insisted Bartholomew Bear. Ricky remains unconvinced.) He’s not a natural Christmas tree. The baubles jangle when he sighs. The star on his head tilts dramatically whenever someone mentions carolling. But he’s promised not to moan... too much!
